text.tspan: SATURDAY SURGE
@unhappychoice detonates 170 commits in a single Saturday. Experts call it unprecedented.
REPO RAMPAGE
@unhappychoice storms through 20+ repos in 7 days. No dependency left behind.
SILENT KILLER
@unhappychoice hunts down curl-eating-404s bug hiding in gitlogue CI for unknown months.
REVIEW MACHINE
@unhappychoice approves 61 PRs in one week. Rubber stamp industry reports record profits.
TRAIT TROUBLE
@unhappychoice forces lintric to prefer concrete members over trait defaults. Traits weep.
FOUR RELEASES
@unhappychoice ships DroidFlyer, Norimaki, splashboard and CircleCI in a single week.
YARN CRISIS
@unhappychoice upgrades jest, eslint, webpack-cli and typescript-eslint simultaneously. Chaos ensues.
RUST NEVER SLEEPS
@unhappychoice bumps dirs, toml, and open crates across gitlogue, steamfetch, and gittype simultaneously.
